name: simulateur-independant-fr
description: Simulateur desktop hors-ligne pour indépendants français : statuts juridiques, cotisations, impôt du foyer et comparateur de statuts.
author: Damien Becherini

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:3524 && npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.test:e2e: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.test:web: vite build --mode web && playwright test --config playwright.web.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:web
scripts.captures: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.captures.config.ts
scripts.mentions-legales: cross-env ECRIRE_MENTIONS_LEGALES=1 vitest run --project logique src/lib/mentions-legales.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:store: npm run transpile:electron && tsc-alias -p src/backend/tsconfig.json && npm run build && node scripts/construire-paquet-store.mjs
